milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting a torch results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. No torches exist anywhere in the scene (pre-placed torch was removed per CommonSenseAgent's recommendation), so the only way to have a torch in inventory is by crafting one from sticks + coal. The recipe (1 coal + 1 stick = 4 torches) is craftable in the 2x2 inventory grid. Player starts with 2 sticks + 1 coal, with additional materials in the chest.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find bedrock' is a locate/observe task — the player must navigate to and visually identify the bedrock chamber. Target is set to the center of the bedrock chamber interior at (8, 1, 1) spawn-relative (chamber spans x=7-10, z=0-3). max_distance=5 ensures the player is inside or at the entrance of the chamber (not just anywhere in the tunnel). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the bedrock walls/floor, modeling actual visual observation.
